## Objective
- Build a complete, playable fashion/avatar game inspired by CocoPPa Play and PurenistaM, drawing on the provided TinierMe, Trello, and fandom links.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions and do not ask clarifying questions.
- Save checks as JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Create an original browser game, “Petal Pop — Style Studio,” with custom SVG avatar art, pastel styling, and locally persisted single-player gameplay.
- Use no external game assets or frameworks.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented avatar customization, closet categories, item ownership, shop and capsule draw, daily rewards, style prompt rewards, saved looks, inspiration likes, rename/pose controls, and responsive navigation.
- Added a live date display, once-per-day style prompt rewards, and capsule duplicate conversion for 60 coins.
- A Playwright smoke run using system Chromium passed studio rendering, equipping, saving/restoring looks, shopping, capsules, inspiration likes, daily gift, and no-page-error checks before the latest updates.

### Active
- Run the updated browser smoke checks against the latest changes and inspect the resulting latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` and `node /tmp/opencode/petal-smoke.mjs`.
2. Read only the latest screenshot, `/tmp/opencode/petal-pop-final.jpg`; fix any issues found and rerun checks.
3. Report completion and note this is an original single-player browser game inspired by the references.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game layout, navigation, avatar SVG, studio, shop, closet, and dialogs.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `game.js`: Game data, outfit rendering, interactions, rewards, and persistence.
- `/tmp/opencode/petal-smoke.mjs`: Playwright interaction checks and latest JPEG capture.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The smoke script launches Chromium via Playwright installed under `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright`, using `/usr/bin/chromium`.
- The local HTTP server is available at `http://localhost:3002/`.
